title: Prospective Binance USD-M L2 profit model with pre-capture collector readiness

parent_experiment.statement: HY-EXP-0022 is frozen DATA_FAIL. HY-EXP-0023 is independent and cannot consume HY-EXP-0022 raw data, smoke evidence, failure evidence, Development data, OOS data or results. Reusing engineering code and strategy semantics does not import experiment evidence.

capture_start.rule: captureStart is the first complete UTC 4h boundary at or after preregistrationCommitTimestamp + 24 hours.
capture_start.boundary_alignment: UTC 4h boundary; boundary hour must be divisible by 4 and no manual boundary is allowed.
capture_start.resolution: Resolve only from the immutable HY-EXP-0023 preregistration commit timestamp; never shorten, move earlier or manually override.
capture_start.engineering_data_before_capture: Allowed only under the isolated ENGINEERING_DRY_RUN root and never eligible for Development, OOS or model training.

time_windows.development_start_rule: Candidate and model eligibility starts at max(proposedDevelopmentStartUtc, captureStart + 180 * 4h); raw prospective capture remains governed by captureStart.

engineering_readiness.minimum_soak_duration_rule: At least 30 uninterrupted minutes before captureStart.
engineering_readiness.symbol_selection: Dynamic PIT USD-M universe; no manually fixed symbol list.
engineering_readiness.readiness_failure_action: STOP; do not begin official HY-EXP-0023 capture and do not move captureStart.

raw_websocket_event.source_exchange_timestamp: k.T or event E, preserved separately
raw_websocket_event.transport_status: If st exists, require st === 1 and reject st === 2; preserve st and ps.

rest_confirmation.timing: Immediate post-boundary request for the just-closed 4h bar only

bar_source.completion_rule: Only a bar with finalClosed=true and closeTime < decisionTime is eligible. Open or incomplete kline events are capture records only, never signal inputs.

field_mapping.rest_array: [openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, closeTime, quoteVolume, tradeCount, ...]
field_mapping.websocket_payload: k.t=openTime, k.T=closeTime, k.o=open, k.h=high, k.l=low, k.c=close, k.v=volume, k.q=quoteVolume, k.n=tradeCount, k.x=finalClosed

bar_precedence_and_reconciliation.acceptance: Accept exactly one normalized bar only when the final WebSocket event and immediate REST confirmation have the same openTime, closeTime, OHLCV, quoteVolume and tradeCount after decimal-string normalization.
bar_precedence_and_reconciliation.single_source: A single source is WAITING_CONFIRMATION and is not eligible for Development; it is not silently accepted.
bar_precedence_and_reconciliation.missing_confirmation: After the bounded confirmation deadline, append BAR_CONFIRMATION_MISSING and fail the required segment/window closed.
bar_precedence_and_reconciliation.conflict: Any field mismatch is BAR_SOURCE_CONFLICT; invalidate the segment and do not choose one source.
bar_precedence_and_reconciliation.duplicate: Identical duplicate final records are retained in raw append-only storage and deduplicated only in the derived validated-bar index by source event identity.
bar_precedence_and_reconciliation.gap: Missing boundary or non-contiguous completed bar is DATA_FAIL; no interpolation or synthetic bar is allowed.

universe_volume.universe: Point-in-time dynamic USD-M perpetual universe selected from prospectively captured exchangeInfo and ticker diagnostics.
universe_volume.priorSixBarQuoteVolume: Sum quoteVolume of exactly the six immediately preceding valid completed 4h contract-price bars for the same symbol.
universe_volume.ticker_role: Diagnostic capture only; it cannot define priorSixBarQuoteVolume, eligibility or a signal feature.
universe_volume.missing_bar_action: Exclude symbol and record DATA_FAIL; never use 24h ticker or current-state backfill.

warmup.earliest_candidate_rule: No candidate before 180 valid post-capture completed bars and developmentStart; earliestCandidateTime = max(developmentStart, captureStart + 180 * 4h).

stream_rules.invalid_segment_policy: Exclude from usable data and append a segment.audit record; never silently repair.

depth_collector.connection_mode: Combined/multiplex depth streams with bounded symbol batches; no uncontrolled one-connection-per-symbol design.
depth_collector.transport_status: If st exists, require st === 1 for USD-M and reject st === 2; preserve st and ps in raw records.
depth_collector.alignment: Per-symbol buffer, snapshot and reconstructor; first applied event must satisfy U <= snapshot.lastUpdateId <= u; later events require pu === previous u.

snapshot_retry.snapshot_too_old_action: Retain raw buffer, request a fresh snapshot, stale-drop only during initialization, then retry overlap.
snapshot_retry.aligned_gap_action: Fail the current segment; never refetch to hide a live gap.

depth_collector.rotation: Start a fresh snapshot/alignment segment for every UTC 4h boundary and whenever reconnect occurs; raw invalid segments remain invalid.

exchange_info_and_funding.exchange_info: Capture the current response prospectively at each universe boundary and for every selected symbol; validate status=TRADING, contractType=PERPETUAL, quoteAsset, onboardDate, tickSize, stepSize, minQty and MIN_NOTIONAL/notional.
exchange_info_and_funding.funding: Capture realized funding rows prospectively with symbol, fundingTime, fundingRate and receivedAt; require fundingTime <= receivedAt.

strategy_semantics.source_reference: HY-EXP-0021 baseline semantics, independently preregistered for HY-EXP-0023
strategy_semantics.candidate_engine: Candidate -> Edge Model -> Net Edge Gate -> Portfolio Risk Gate -> Advisory

regime.bull: BTC fastSMA > slowSMA, BTC close > slowSMA, and at least ceil(0.5 * eligible universe size) symbols close above their own slowSMA
regime.bear: BTC fastSMA < slowSMA, BTC close < slowSMA, and at least ceil(0.5 * eligible universe size) symbols close below their own slowSMA
regime.sideways: All other states, including insufficient universe, are SIDEWAYS and NO_TRADE

candidate.long: BULL regime and completed-bar close strictly above prior 120 completed-bar high
candidate.short: BEAR regime and completed-bar close strictly below prior 120 completed-bar low
candidate.breakout_distance: Feature only; never expectedPriceEdgeBps and never a direct PnL estimate
candidate.entry_price: First fillable full-L2 executable price at or after decisionTime; never theoretical bar open

edge_model.training: Expanding walk-forward ridge regression fitted separately by candidate cell; lambda=10; intercept unpenalized; no hyperparameter search or feature selection.
edge_model.uncertainty: Training-only residual variance plus q90 absolute chronological OOF residual; standard error is sqrt(sigma2 * (1 + x' inverse(X'X + lambda I) x)); confidence z=1.645.
edge_model.calibration: At least 100 chronological OOF rows per cell; fit realized = a + b * rawPrediction with ridge lambda=1, unpenalized intercept, b clamped to [0.25,4].
edge_model.insufficient_sample_action: edge.available=false and NO_TRADE; no pooled or breakout fallback

net_edge.funding_source: Prospectively captured settled funding rows known at decisionTime and realized through exit
net_edge.conservative_formula: expectedPriceEdgeBps + expectedFundingBps - roundTripFeeBps - stressedBookCost - roundTripImpactBufferBps - roundTripLatencyBufferBps - 1.645 * uncertaintyPenaltyBps - fundingStressBps

exit.long_channel_exit: Completed close strictly below prior 60 completed-bar low
exit.short_channel_exit: Completed close strictly above prior 60 completed-bar high
exit.profit_protection: Enabled at 1 entry ATR; ratcheted distance is 1 entry ATR using sequence-valid executable L2 high/low water mark
exit.terminal_exit: First valid executable book at finalOosEndExclusive; not a fixed 24-hour close
exit.counterfactuals: Exploratory annotations only and cannot change the frozen exit or promotion result

risk.exchange_filters: Use only prospectively captured exchangeInfo filters at decisionTime; missing filters invalidate the candidate
risk.quantity_rounding: Round down to captured stepSize; never round up

ENGINEERING_DRY_RUN.record_rule: Engineering records must remain under the canonical engineering root and are never Development or OOS eligible.

DEVELOPMENT_CAPTURE.record_rule: captureStart <= every causal source timestamp and receivedAt < developmentEndExclusive
DEVELOPMENT_CAPTURE.eligibility_rule: developmentStart <= decisionTime < developmentEndExclusive and all 180 warmup bars are prospective

FINAL_OOS_CAPTURE.record_rule: finalOosStart <= every causal source timestamp and receivedAt < finalOosEndExclusive

time_firewall.canonical_root_containment: Resolve both paths canonically; actual path must equal the mode root or be a descendant. Text containing HY-EXP-0023 is not identity proof.

data_quality_gates.invalid_segment_policy: Exclude and append audit; any required coverage loss fails closed.

oos_data_policy.before_development_pass: Write, hash and integrity-check only; no query, inspection, summary, calculation, training, optimization, backtest or metrics.
oos_data_policy.after_development_pass: Only the explicit post-pass operation allowlist may read sealed OOS data.
oos_data_policy.after_development_fail: Final OOS is permanently unreadable for HY-EXP-0023.

stop_rules.acceptance: This preregistration must be accepted before any HY-EXP-0023 official capture, Development query, model training, backtest, PnL calculation or Final-OOS research read.
stop_rules.collector_readiness: The collector must be running and healthy before captureStart; any readiness failure sets STOP and does not move captureStart.
stop_rules.capture_fail: Any missing required bar, L2, exchangeInfo, funding, timestamp, sequence, coverage, provenance or hash gate sets DATA_FAIL and STOP.
stop_rules.development_fail: Any Development gate failure permanently denies Final-OOS research reads and creates no result, trades or PnL artifact.
stop_rules.no_window_change: Any window or captureStart change requires a new experiment ID and preregistration.
